description: account/v1 — A cloud account owned by a single team, reconciled by the TypeScript demo worker. Its readiness is GATED on a providerconfig: the provider can't mint an id without an id_pattern, so it advertises RS- (work parks) until the config lands, then RS+ (work flows).

team_name.description: Owner team name; appears in tags.

config_schema.description: The account provider's config: the name pattern it needs before it can mint an id. The provider's readiness is gated on this — no config, no work.

id_pattern.description: Account-id template; `{team_name}` is substituted at work time, e.g. "acc-{team_name}-prod".

account_id.description: Provider-issued account id, formatted from the config's id_pattern.
